Dolgan Outpost is occupied by the enemy.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the enemy unit's leader and secure the base.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Prudent Purson[/System:Color] at Dolgan Outpost.
The Dolgan Outpost is now under your control.

Enalda Control Base is occupied by the enemy.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the enemy unit's leader and secure the base.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Tranquil Morax[/System:Color] at Enalda Control Base.
Enalda Control Base is now under your control.

Enemy reinforcements have arrived at the 3rd Gate.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the Large Machine God Soldier to stop them.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Reinforcement M104[/System:Color] near the 3rd Gate.

By stopping the enemy reinforcements,[XENO:n ]
you improved the situation on the battlefield.

The enemy occupies the area around the Radio Tower.[XENO:n ]
Defeating them may turn the battle in your favour.[XENO:n ]
Defeat their leader to diminish their forces.
Defeat [System:Color name=item ]Lightning Ronve[/System:Color] near the Radio Tower.

You defeated the enemy leader near the Radio Tower.[XENO:n ]
Their forces dwindled and the battle turned in your favour.

A decisive battle between Homs and Machine God Soldiers.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado, the only weapon effective against them,[XENO:n ]
to defeat the Machine God Soldiers around you!
Defeat 3 Machine God Soldiers in the vicinity.
You cleared all the nearby Machine God Soldiers!

Dunban with the Monado is the Homs army's only hope.[XENO:n ]
Use the Monado, the only weapon effective against them,[XENO:n ]
to defeat the incoming Machine God Soldiers!
Defeat 3 reinforcing Machine God Soldiers.
You wiped out the reinforcing Machine God Soldiers!

No matter how many you defeat, their numbers never fall.[XENO:n ]
But you can't retreat in a battle for survival.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the next wave of Machine God Soldiers!
